text:
alex: Heads-up — change window tonight 23:00 UTC. Cross-service rollout plan below. Please ack if you’re onwatch.

alex: TL;DR: pin runtime -> v2.4.1, api -> v1.8.0, console -> 3.2.0 (schema pinned), router -> header-split enabled. Canary + staged traffic.

maria: ack. I’ll own console telemetry & release notes publishing. Link to draft release notes: https://confluence/release/rdw-2026-03-23 (will publish once canary green).

cheng: ack. I’ll handle runtime canary and kernel selection. Proposed canary: runtime 5% (10 instances), API 3% then ramp. Router header-split at 1% then 10% after 20m.

sam: I’m primary oncall for the window (pager me if anything hits). Backup is cheng. Rollback owner is alex.

alex: Rollback criteria (agreed):
- p99 latency increase > 120ms vs baseline for 10m AND error rate > 0.5% OR
- request failures (5xx) > 1% sustained for 5m OR
- console schema migrations produce >1% parse errors in logs.
If any trigger hits, we roll runtime back first, then API, then un-split router.

maria: adding one more: quality regression on our eval prompts (run opt-eval set) — if median Rouge/accuracy drops by >3 points, abort. I’ll post eval run results at +15m into canary.

alex: Deploybot commands we’ll run (dry-run verified):
```
/deploy runtime --tag v2.4.1 --canary 5 --watch 1800 --pin-tag console_schema=3.2.0
/deploy api --tag v1.8.0 --canary 3 --watch 1200
/deploy router --feature header-split --percent 1 --watch 1200
```
deploy-bot: Command accepted. Scheduling runtime canary at 2026-03-23T23:00:00Z. Will post status updates in this thread.

maria: I’ll publish final release note blurb 10m before start. Please include migration note about console schema pin.

cheng: Quick compatibility note: runtime v2.4.1 requires kernel flag `enable_fast_attn=true` on G5 nodes. I’ll ensure node pools have the flag. If any pool missing flag, hold deploy for that pool only and route around.

sam: Ops checklist:
- Quiesce non-essential background jobs 22:50 UTC
- Increase logs retention to 7d for canary windows
- Prepare emergency rollback runbook pinned to this thread

alex: Release notes draft snippet (maria can copy/paste):
"Runtime: v2.4.1 — improved attention kernel, latency optimizations, and KV cache fixes. API: v1.8.0 — minor compat changes for tool-calling. Console: 3.2.0 — schema pin to avoid parsing regressions. Router: header-split feature gated rollout."

maria: pasted and published. https://confluence/release/rdw-2026-03-23/notes (public/internal sections done).

cheng: heads-up: will run a quick smoke after runtime canary warms (curl /health + synthetic prompt). Expect ~5-7m warmup.

deploy-bot: runtime canary started on pool g5-canary-1 (10 instances). Canary id: cb-8850001112-rt. Will post metrics in 5m.

alex: thanks. Monitor these dashboards: console-parse-errors, runtime-latency-p99, api-5xx-rate, router-header-split-errors. I’ll be watching cost/throughput too in case batching changes spike tokens.

maria: eval job kicked off: `opt-eval --suite canary-core-10k --model runtime:v2.4.1` — results ETA ~12m.

sam: oncall reachable. Will escalate to SRE if any infra anomalies.

cheng: initial smoke looks clean — /health OK, p50/p90 in line. Waiting for full metrics window.

deploy-bot: runtime canary metrics (5m): p99 +8ms, 5xx=0.02%, cpu stable. No console parse errors observed.

alex: +1 so far. Proceed with API canary once runtime reaches 20m stable.

maria: eval results: median score delta -0.6 points (within tolerance). Publishing note: canary green.

deploy-bot: api canary started on pool api-canary-2 (3 instances). Canary id: cb-8850001112-api.

cheng: Router header-split at 1% initiated. Watch for routing anomalies.

deploy-bot: All canaries green after staged window. Rolling to 25% router after 20m, then full ramp if stable.

sam: final checklist: confirm logs, release notes links in handoff, and set rollback label on PRs. After 2h stabilization we’ll mark release complete.

alex: Great work team. If anything happens, call the rollback: `/rollback runtime --tag v2.4.0` and we’ll follow the rollback playbook.

cheng: noted. I’ll prepare the rollback command ready in terminal.

maria: tagging this thread in the release ticket: RDW-2026-03-23. Closing monitoring loop. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Canaries promoted to full rollout. Release marked "in-progress". Will update thread on completion.

alex: closing this coordination thread — will post final release-complete timestamp once stabilization window ends. Good job.
